$comment: Immutable source pins and licence classification for the Tesserafin FFmpeg runtime (F0, issue #229). Every sha256 was computed from bytes fetched from the recorded URL; every git component is pinned to a resolved commit. ci/ffmpeg/verify-components.sh gates this file.
$platformComment: The runtime identifiers this manifest may classify a component against. A component with no 'architectures' key is applicable to EVERY platform listed here, so adding a platform widens the unrestricted components by construction — which is why every component that is not portable now says so explicitly. ci/ffmpeg/verify-components.sh refuses an 'architectures' value outside this list.

ffmpeg.whyFork: Tesserafin.MediaEncoding/Encoder/EncoderValidator.cs requires the 'tonemapx' filter, which exists only in the Jellyfin fork

components.name: amf-headers
components.requiredBy: AMD AMF encoders (h264/hevc/av1_amf). x86-64 only: upstream's builder disables AMF on arm64, and v1.5.0 is the SDK version the v7.1.4-3 patch series compiles against — v1.4.35 lacks AMF_VIDEO_ENCODER_AV1_B_PIC_PATTERN and fails to build.
components.architectureComment: AMF is an AMD x86-64 stack on both operating systems it targets; upstream's builder disables it on arm64, where enabling it fails the build rather than widening the runtime.

components.name: dav1d
components.requiredBy: libdav1d — the AV1 decoder the server requires

components.name: expat
components.requiredBy: fontconfig XML configuration parsing

components.name: fontconfig
components.requiredBy: font discovery for subtitle burn-in (2.14.2: the last release that still ships autotools; 2.15 requires meson >= 0.60, above the pinned builder's 0.56)

components.name: freetype
components.requiredBy: subtitle glyph rasterisation for libass

components.name: fribidi
components.requiredBy: bidirectional text for libass

components.name: glslang
components.license: BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND MIT AND Apache-2.0
components.requiredBy: GLSL front end for shaderc (libplacebo and FFmpeg's Vulkan filters compile their shaders at run time). Built in-tree under shaderc. The GPL-3.0 Bison text in its LICENSE.txt covers a parser the project removed; nothing generated by Bison is built.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.name: harfbuzz
components.requiredBy: complex text shaping for libass (8.5.0: the newest release buildable with the pinned builder's meson 0.56)

components.name: lame
components.requiredBy: libmp3lame — MP3 encode

components.name: libass
components.requiredBy: subtitle burn-in

components.name: libbluray
components.requiredBy: the bluray: protocol — Blu-ray ISO images played from a session (#305). Built without BD-J, libxml2, freetype or fontconfig; AACS and BD+ are neither linked nor bundled (libbluray dlopen()s them only if the host installed them)
components.architectureComment: Disc-image reading is added to the linux runtimes first; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg), where disc images are a recorded residual.

components.name: libdrm
components.requiredBy: DRM ioctls beneath libva
components.architectureComment: DRM is a Linux kernel interface. Stated explicitly rather than left unrestricted so that declaring win-x64 in 'platforms' cannot silently make it Windows-applicable.

components.name: libdvdnav
components.requiredBy: the dvdvideo demuxer — DVD ISO images played from a session (#305); FFmpeg 7.1 requires >= 6.1.1
components.architectureComment: Disc-image reading is added to the linux runtimes first; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg), where disc images are a recorded residual.

components.name: libdvdread
components.requiredBy: the dvdvideo demuxer and libdvdnav — reads DVD ISO images directly (6.1.3: the last autotools release; FFmpeg 7.1 requires >= 6.1.2). Built without libdvdcss: encrypted discs are not a supported source
components.architectureComment: Disc-image reading is added to the linux runtimes first; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg), where disc images are a recorded residual.

components.name: libogg
components.requiredBy: container for libvorbis

components.name: libplacebo
components.requiredBy: EncoderValidator._requiredFilters names 'libplacebo': Vulkan HDR tone-mapping and subtitle burn-in without the software fallback (maintainer decision on #342). Latest release; jellyfin-ffmpeg's v7.1.4 builder pins v7.351.0, and this tree's FFmpeg 7.1.4 + fork series configures and builds against v7.360.1. Its submodules (jinja, markupsafe, glad, fast_float) are build-time code generators and headers pinned by this commit.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.name: libudfread
components.requiredBy: UDF file system reader beneath libbluray — opens Blu-ray ISO images (1.1.2: the last autotools release; 1.2.0 needs meson above the pinned builder's 0.56)
components.architectureComment: Disc-image reading is added to the linux runtimes first; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg), where disc images are a recorded residual.

components.name: libunibreak
components.requiredBy: line breaking for libass

components.name: libva
components.requiredBy: VAAPI encode/decode/filters. Pinned to the NEWEST stable release, not the oldest in the support matrix: libva loads a VA driver through vaDriverInit_<major>_<minor> and is backward compatible with older drivers but not forward compatible with newer ones. A bundled 2.17 could not load this host's vaDriverInit_1_20 driver at all.
components.architectureComment: VAAPI is the Linux video-acceleration interface; Windows uses DXVA2/D3D11VA/D3D12VA/QSV instead.

components.name: libvorbis
components.requiredBy: libvorbis encode

components.name: libvpl
components.requiredBy: Intel QSV encode/decode and the *_qsv filters. x86-64 only: oneVPL targets Intel GPUs and upstream's builder disables it on arm64.
components.architectureComment: oneVPL targets Intel GPUs on x86-64; upstream disables it on arm64. The win-x64 runtime reaches Quick Sync through the same dispatcher.

components.name: libvpx
components.requiredBy: libvpx / libvpx-vp9 decode

components.name: meson
components.requiredBy: Build tool only, never linked or shipped: libplacebo needs meson >= 0.63 and the bullseye builder carries 0.56. Pure Python, run from this pinned checkout for the libplacebo step alone.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.name: nv-codec-headers
components.requiredBy: NVENC/NVDEC/CUVID and the *_cuda filters

components.name: opencl-headers
components.requiredBy: the *_opencl filters
components.architectureComment: OpenCL is a named gap in the win-x64 runtime (#236), not an oversight: the *_opencl filters are absent there and the Windows hardware surface is DXVA2/D3D11VA/D3D12VA/AMF/QSV/NVENC. Recorded the same way libplacebo is in 'excluded'.

components.name: opencl-icd-loader
components.requiredBy: the *_opencl filters need a real -lOpenCL to link; the Khronos ICD loader supplies it and defers vendor discovery to /etc/OpenCL/vendors at runtime, so an absent GPU is a controlled failure rather than a link error
components.refComment: annotated tag v2024.05.08 (object 59363628…) peeled to its commit
components.architectureComment: Follows opencl-headers: no OpenCL surface in the win-x64 runtime, so no ICD loader is linked there.

components.name: openssl
components.requiredBy: https:// protocol for remote media sources
components.architectureComment: The win-x64 runtime takes TLS from Schannel, the operating system's own provider, so no OpenSSL is fetched, built, linked or shipped there. Restricting the component is what makes that provable from the manifest rather than only from the configure line.

components.name: opus
components.requiredBy: libopus — Opus encode

components.name: shaderc
components.requiredBy: Runtime GLSL-to-SPIR-V compiler for libplacebo (-Dshaderc=enabled) and FFmpeg's Vulkan filters (--enable-libshaderc). v2024.2 rather than jellyfin's newer pin: that one needs cmake >= 3.22 and the builder carries 3.18.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.name: spirv-headers
components.requiredBy: SPIR-V grammar headers for SPIRV-Tools and glslang, built in-tree under shaderc.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.name: spirv-tools
components.requiredBy: SPIR-V optimiser and validator linked into shaderc_combined, built in-tree under shaderc.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.name: svt-av1
components.requiredBy: libsvtav1 — software AV1 encode

components.name: vulkan-headers
components.requiredBy: Vulkan API headers and registry for FFmpeg (--enable-vulkan) and libplacebo. Headers only: FFmpeg and libplacebo (-Dvk-proc-addr=disabled) load the system libvulkan.so.1 at run time, so the runtime gains no DT_NEEDED entry. v1.4.337 is jellyfin-ffmpeg's pin; libplacebo v7.35x needs Vulkan 1.4 headers.
components.architectureComment: Vulkan is a linux runtime capability here; win-x64 keeps its own MSYS2 component set (ci/windows/ffmpeg) and the Vulkan gap there is a recorded residual.

components.requiredBy: libx264 — the software H.264 encoder the server transcodes with

components.requiredBy: libx265 — software HEVC encode

components.requiredBy: zscale — required filter (submodule graphengine is pinned by the parent tree's gitlink)

excluded.fdk-aac-stripped: libfdk_aac is classified nonfree by FFmpeg; FFmpeg's native AAC encoder covers the requirement
excluded.libzvbi: GPL-2.0-or-later teletext decoding; not referenced by any Tesserafin capability
excluded.libsrt: SRT transport; the 'srt' entry in _requiredEncoders is the SubRip SUBTITLE encoder, which is native
excluded.libopenmpt: tracker-module playback; no Tesserafin call site
excluded.chromaprint: audio fingerprinting; no Tesserafin call site
excluded.gmp: only reachable through the excluded components
excluded.libxml2: DASH/IMF demuxing; not a Tesserafin capability requirement
excluded.libne10: superseded by compiler intrinsics on aarch64
excluded.rkmpp: Rockchip SBC codepath; outside the declared linux-x64/linux-arm64 support matrix
excluded.rkrga: Rockchip SBC codepath; outside the declared support matrix
excluded.mingw / dxva / schannel / mfx / x11 / xo: Excluded as SOURCE COMPONENTS on every platform, which is not the same as excluding the capability. The Windows-side pieces — the mingw-w64 toolchain and CRT, the DXVA2/D3D11VA/D3D12VA headers and Schannel — are not built from source by any Tesserafin runtime: on win-x64 (#236) they arrive inside the digest-pinned, signature-verified MSYS2 CLANG64 package set that W1-R retained, and are enabled through ci/windows/ffmpeg/ffmpeg-configure.win-x64.txt. libmfx is superseded by libvpl, and X11 is excluded outright because Tesserafin ships headless on every platform.
